create_contiguous_distributed_sampler: create a ContiguousDistributedSampler to shard dataset indices across multi-node distributed training replicas
create_contiguous_distributed_sampler_fo: create a ContiguousDistributedSamplerForTest to evenly shard a dataset for testing across multiple replicas
create_script_encoder: create a ScriptEncoder to wrap a transform and encoder for TorchScript serialization with optional quantization
create_script_multi_encoder: create a ScriptMultiEncoder to ensemble multiple encoders with configurable weights and optional quantization
use_maybe_add_title: use maybe_add_title to prepend a title with a separator token to a text string conditionally
